alt: Redacted screenshot of an X post claiming 46,XX androgen insensitivity caused masculine traits
claim: A post states that the author has two X chromosomes (46,XX) and that an intersex condition causing androgen insensitivity made their body develop in a male hormone environment, producing masculine traits.
fact: Androgen insensitivity syndrome (AIS) is caused by variants in the AR gene, which makes the androgen receptor. It affects people with 46,XY chromosomes. Because the body cannot respond fully, or at all, to androgens such as testosterone, AIS leads to female-typical or under-masculinized development, not masculine traits. The AR gene is on the X chromosome, and AIS is inherited in an X-linked pattern. People with 46,XX chromosomes are not affected by AIS in this way. When a 46,XX person develops masculine traits, the most common medical cause is congenital adrenal hyperplasia (CAH), a different condition in which the adrenal glands make too many androgens. Rarer causes include 46,XX testicular DSD and ovotesticular DSD.

rarity.text: Complete androgen insensitivity syndrome (CAIS) affects 2 to 5 in 100,000 newborn females. Partial AIS is thought to be at least as common.
rarity.label: MedlinePlus Genetics: Androgen insensitivity syndrome

rarity.text: Classic congenital adrenal hyperplasia (21-hydroxylase deficiency) occurs in about 1 in 15,000 newborns. The non-classic form affects about 1 in 1,000 people.
rarity.label: MedlinePlus Genetics: 21-hydroxylase deficiency

health.text: Germ cell tumors of the gonads: the risk is increased in CAIS and rises after puberty, and it is higher in partial AIS (PAIS) than in CAIS.
health.label: Kosti et al., Maturitas 2019

health.text: Low bone density (osteopenia and osteoporosis), especially after early removal of the gonads. Hormone therapy may improve bone density but does not normalize it.
health.label: Kosti et al., Maturitas 2019; Bertelloni et al., Sex Dev 2017

health.text: Infertility is the rule in CAIS and PAIS.
health.label: Kosti et al., Maturitas 2019

health.text: Psychological support is recommended, because rates of psychiatric conditions are higher.
health.label: Kosti et al., Maturitas 2019
